answer: Throwaway keys can outvote a small honest set. I would ship a sponsor garden: each new identity needs three established backers who lock 25 coins in a sable bond for six epochs, and the recruit's vote weight starts as a silt delta until that window closes without a proven clone. Every extra persona costs three fresh bonds plus six epochs of backer exposure. Peers check sponsor signatures on the live registry and slash a backer whose recruit is later shown to be a duplicate. It fails if one whale reuses the same three backers at scale, so the registry caps concurrent sponsorships per address.
